description: Hashing and encoding of PUBLIC data: op=blake2b (hex data, out_len bytes 1-64, optional personal), twox128 (text, Substrate xxHash), base58_encode (hex data), base58_decode (base58 text; plain Base58, no checksum). Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: hash_tool
title: BLAKE2b / twox128 / Base58 (dev tool)
